title: Preference.
bodyText: Preference for a lease of public lands within an industrial park shall be given to an eligible lessee who is a small business. For the purpose of this section, "small business" means the same as "small business concern" under section 210-1.
bodyHtml: [§171-137]  Preference.  Preference for a lease of public lands within an industrial park shall be given to an eligible lessee who is a small business.  For the purpose of this section, "small business" means the same as "small business concern" under section 210-1. [L 1988, c 361, pt of §1]
